what.a: OpenKoto is an open-source, AI-powered language-learning app. Instead of a fixed course, you learn from novels, song lyrics and articles you choose, and review the words you collect with spaced repetition.

free.a: Yes. All local features are free, and the source code is Apache 2.0 licensed. An optional free account syncs a starter library; paid plans add unlimited sync, hosted AI and CLI access.

platforms.a: The web app at openkoto.com, iPhone and iPad (App Store), and desktop apps for macOS, Windows and Linux (GitHub Releases). There is also a command-line tool and an MCP server.

privacy.a: Without an account, everything stays on your device. If you sign in, the data you sync is stored on Cloudflare so it can follow you across devices. We don't sell your data or train models on it, and you can export or delete it at any time.

ai.q: Do I need an AI API key?
ai.a: You can bring your own key from Google AI Studio, 302.AI, Kimi or any OpenAI-compatible provider — see the docs for step-by-step guides. Paid plans also include hosted AI, so no key is required.

agents.q: What are the CLI, MCP and agent skill?
agents.a: They let AI agents such as Claude work with your OpenKoto library: run a review session, look up words, read your books or save lyrics translations. Install with npm i -g @openkoto/cli, or connect to https://openkoto.com/mcp.
